meta.title: Dancers | Take 3 Agency
meta.description: Trained dancers for film, television, commercial and live: every style, screen-ready. Take 3 Agency supplies contemporary, commercial, period, ballroom, street and ensemble dancers, from solo artists to full ensembles.
meta.ogDescription: Trained dancers for film, television, commercial and live: every style, screen-ready.

hero.title: DANCERS
hero.lede: Trained dancers for film, television, commercial and live: every style, screen-ready.

genres.name: Contemporary
genres.blurb: Technically trained contemporary artists for narrative and abstract movement: floor work, partnering and release-based styles, comfortable improvising to direction on set.

genres.name: Commercial
genres.blurb: Sharp, camera-ready commercial dancers for promos, campaigns and live performance, fast with choreography and consistent take to take.

genres.name: Jazz & musical theatre
genres.blurb: Triple-threat jazz and musical theatre dancers who sing, act and hold a line: ensemble numbers, featured spots and stage-to-screen adaptations.

genres.name: Period & historical
genres.blurb: Dancers drilled in court, regency, ragtime, swing and other era-specific social dance, styled and rehearsed to the production’s period.

genres.name: Ballroom
genres.blurb: Competition-level ballroom and Latin couples (waltz, foxtrot, tango, quickstep and more), able to perform full routines or background social dancing.

genres.name: Latin
genres.blurb: Salsa, bachata, samba and Argentine tango specialists, from competition couples to social-dance crowds with the real feel of the floor.

genres.name: Street
genres.blurb: Breakers, hip hop, popping, locking and krump artists from the UK battle scene, with the power moves and freestyle depth to hold a featured frame.

genres.name: Heels
genres.blurb: Commercial heels and femme-style dancers with the technique to perform full routines in heels for promos, campaigns and live shows.

genres.name: Bollywood & cultural
genres.blurb: Bollywood, bhangra, Afrobeats and other culturally specific styles, cast from artists trained in the tradition rather than approximating it.

items.name:
Jason
Gilkinson
items.credits: Strictly Come Dancing & Burn The Floor
items.quote: Take 3 Agency have turned out to be the creative connection I have long been looking for. Tyler and Chanel understand instantly not only the type of talent I’m looking for but always connect me to artists who really enhance the creative process. This type of instinct doesn’t come along very often in our industry.

items.name:
James
Cousins
items.quote: Working with Take3 makes the process of casting and hiring artists extremely smooth and efficient. Tyler and the team really understand what’s needed for my work and I was thrilled.

items.name:
Shelley
Maxwell
items.quote: Every brief I’ve sent has come back with dancers who were right on the first look. The shortlists are considered, the admin is invisible and the artists arrive prepared.

items.name:

Murray
items.quote: On tight commercial turnarounds I need availability confirmed fast and no surprises on set. Take 3 deliver both, every time.

items.name:

Baker

items.name:

Murray

items.name:
